Dear Harbor & Pine team,

Opening your internal developer portal to every product team is the kind of shared tooling I like working on.

I have two years of experience building TypeScript services at Tessellate Labs, including the Node.js invoicing service that issues about 9,000 invoices a month. I also moved four services to Docker Compose and wrote the runbook our on-call rotation uses, so I understand what it means to own reliability.

I am currently learning Go and Kubernetes. I know the posting asks for five years and production Kubernetes. When nobody at work knew Docker Compose, I learned it and moved four services.

Could we have a short call about the Platform team?

Best regards,
Rania Haroon
